HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

5. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

6. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

7. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   D. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

13. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

----
